{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of rows with customer_age = -1: {len(missing_age)}')

# Check revenue format
print(f'First few revenue values: {sales["revenue"].head().tolist()}')"}
